main.description: Check the code sent by net.krao.phone.requestCode. On success the number is the viewer's verified phone (replacing an earlier one). Requires service auth for the rewards service.

phone.description: The number the code was sent to.

errors.name: InvalidPhone
errors.description: Not a phone number in E.164 form.

errors.name: PhoneNotSupported
errors.description: Numbers of this country cannot be verified here.

errors.name: CodeExpired
errors.description: No code is waiting for this number, or it expired.

errors.name: TooManyAttempts
errors.description: Too many wrong codes: ask for a new one.

errors.name: PhoneUnavailable
errors.description: Phone verification is not set up on this service.
